messages:
olivia: meet Kumo, the office ferret who thinks my desk is a medieval fortress. pic: https://i.imgur.com/KumoFort.jpg :smiling_face_with_three_hearts:
ben: ferret energy. also that tail in the air = high level mischief. :hotsprings:
sasha: he stole my pen last week and is now a very successful pen tycoon. evidence: tiny vault under keyboard.
lee: quick PSA: do not leave snacks within 3ft unless you want Kumo to file a formal claim.
olivia: Kumo also invented a new lounging position called "the noodle tuck." will add slow-mo gif later.
ben: question: is Kumo trained to fetch? or does he fetch but then replace item with socks?
sasha: he fetches, inspects for approval, and then buries the item in a pile designated for "important things."
ops-bot: reminder: please check allergy preferences before bringing ferrets into common areas. :information_source:
lee: poll: Bring Kumo for "paws at the post" demo on Friday? reply yes/no
olivia: yes! he will bring a demo of stealth mode.
ben: yes. demand: someone bring a tiny hat.
sasha: no unless hat is proportional. previous hats caused indignation.
olivia: video upload: small clip of Kumo parachuting into a shoebox. contains chirpy squeaks. https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ (jk, real clip in drive)
ben: caption idea: "If you need me, i'll be under the swivel chair."
sasha: minor chore request: please move the plant pot by the window, Kumo has declared it his lookout and we don't want a pot-opoly incident.
lee: i will glue a tiny flag on said lookout. for science.
olivia: final note: Kumo will accept bribery in the form of shredded sticky notes. DO NOT ask why.
ops-bot: reaction logged :heart: from 4 users. Event scheduled: if Kumo demo happens ops will post a reminder and a liability waiver (just kidding).
